---
title: "MEC1019: Sustainable Processes"
subtitle: "Design project — microcontroller notes"
---

These notes build up, step by step, the electronics and programming needed
for the design project: controlling a circuit with an Arduino microcontroller
and switching a load between a renewable energy source (RES) and a battery
with relays. Each part has worked calculations, cleaned-up Arduino code and
links to interactive applets.

## Notes

| # | Notes | Topics |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Arduino basics, LEDs and `digitalWrite`](notes/01-arduino-basics-and-leds.md) | Breadboards, LED resistors, Arduino Uno anatomy, IDE setup, variables, `for` loops, buzzer alarm |
| 2 | [`analogWrite`, voltage dividers and potentiometers](notes/02-analogwrite-dividers-and-potentiometers.md) | PWM pins, 8-bit resolution, fading LEDs, Ohm's law, divider design, pots |
| 3 | [Loops, alarms and Pulse Width Modulation](notes/03-loops-pwm-and-alarms.md) | Buzzer on its own pin, duty cycle, PWM ↔ `analogWrite` |
| 5 | [Voltage dividers for voltage monitoring](notes/05-voltage-dividers.md) | Scaling a RES voltage to 0–5 V, choosing R₁ and R₂ |
| 6 | [Potentiometers and `analogRead`](notes/06-potentiometers.md) | 10-bit ADC, dimmer, threshold switching, voltage bands |
| 7 | [Relays](notes/07-relays.md) | COM/NC/NO, opto-isolators, active-LOW modules, switching LEDs and sources |
| 8 | [Renewable source with battery backup](notes/08-res-battery-switchover.md) | Building the complete switch-over system |
| — | [Finished circuit and Arduino code](notes/finished-circuit.md) | Six-step build, full wiring table, final code walkthrough |

(There is no Part 4.)

## Quick reference

| Concept | Formula / code |
|---|---|
| Ohm's law | $V = IR$ |
| LED resistor | $R = (V_s - V_f)/I$ |
| Series resistors | $R_T = R_1 + R_2$ |
| Voltage divider | $V_{out} = V_s\,R_2/(R_1+R_2)$ |
| Divider for 5 V max | $R_1 = (V_{max}/5 - 1)\,R_2$ |
| PWM duty cycle | on time / period × 100 % |
| `analogWrite` value | $255/5 \times V$ (0–255, `~` pins 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11) |
| `analogRead` to volts | `V = (5. / 1023.) * analogRead(pin);` |
| Relay terminals | COM → NC when off, COM → NO when on (module inputs usually active-LOW) |
